description: The record of the rendering layer: a per-route map of models plus the forces, alternatives and consequences behind it.
One application can mix static, SSG, ISR, SSR and SPA routes; each route gets the cheapest model that meets its SEO, personalization and freshness needs.
The facts that push a decision: share of traffic from search, data freshness, personalization, traffic spikes, budget and team size. They belong in the context.
How long shared HTML may lag behind the data (the `revalidate` time of ISR). A negative consequence that other parts of the system must compensate for.
The real options weighed and the fact from the context that ruled each out. Without them, an ADR cannot be revisited honestly.
